gen-gf-baumans-gf-andada-pro: Andada Pro draws its serif letters with middling stroke contrast, leaving counters the eye can slip in and out of. Baumans makes blunt statements; Andada Pro keeps a paragraph moving.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-aref-ruqaa: Distinctive from the first letter, Baumans bends every stroke like pipe, at constant width. Aref Ruqaa follows with open bowls and a gentle swelling and tapering along its curves.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Baumans, with its crescent-wrench c and a flat line round every curve, makes a firm, distinctive front. Aref Ruqaa Ink then follows, its stroke weight shifting noticeably but never dramatically.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-average: Average leaves gaping mouths on the e and thickens its curves slightly, like a reed pen. Average would carry a long text with a literary, authoritative hush, soft where Baumans is blunt.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-besley: Dignified serif text sits below Baumans, whose lowercase a has no thin hairline strokes anywhere. Besley eases its terminals and joins only slightly, keeping crossbars a touch thinner than stems.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-biz-udpmincho: Refined and traditional, BIZ UDPMincho keeps its thicks mild and its exits wide enough to let light through. Under Baumans, a long text glides along, letters never touching or crowding.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bona-nova: Bona Nova is an editorial, bookish serif with a restrained swell. Its curves hold their mouths open and narrow gradually from stem to terminal, giving a long text real ease against Baumans.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-bona-nova-sc: Refined and classic, Bona Nova SC keeps every small counter unclogged, with gentle stroke modulation throughout. But Baumans holds its line width through every turn, a flat display voice over that gentle variation.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-brawler: A c like a crescent wrench opened wide marks Baumans. Brawler, a serif whose arches thin slightly where they leave the stem, gives that bluntness a literate, refined partner.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-brygada-1918: Baumans draws like a technical drawing pen, every stroke the same weight, with a crescent-wrench c. Brygada 1918 is steady yet faintly modulated, with the mild swelling of a worn felt marker.
